title: Flood Fill
summary: Recolor the connected component containing a starting cell in a grid.
algorithmSteps: Remember the starting color and stop early if it already equals the replacement.
Use a stack to visit cells in the connected component.
Recolor each visited cell and add same-colored orthogonal neighbors.

examples.explanation: Every 1 connected to the center by an orthogonal path is recolored.

edgeCases: Stop immediately when the replacement color matches the starting color.
